Tests batch URI extraction API (extract_batch)

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract_batch("[{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf\"}]", "{}");
```
